offer.text: Deliver four lanterns to this recognized workshop. Payment: six emeralds and a civic service honor. There is no fee. Unavailable workshop services pause your work; leaving the guild does not cancel it.

accept.text: The workshop reserves your commission. Bring four lanterns to this issuer.

decline.text: You remain welcome to pursue ordinary guild service.

in_progress.text: Four lanterns will supply the workshop. Your accepted terms remain unchanged.

ready.text: Your lanterns are ready to inspect.

complete.text: Four lanterns received; six emeralds paid. Your verified service will be recorded as a civic honor.
